meta.parties: Silva Et Al. v. Singho Et Al

rules.statement: A decree in a mortgage action for the payment of money due on the mortgage bond and in default thereof for the sale of the mortgaged property, and the realization of any balance of the debt still remaining unpaid after such sale, is a 'decree for the payment of money' within the meaning of section 337, Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: "I have no doubt that it is a decree for payment of money. It begins by ordering the defendants to pay the whole debt."
